title: Fittings
description: This project changes the netherite sword to fittings
body: This project changes the netherite sword to fittings. It also changes the name to fittings in Russian and English. This resource pack provides several versions. In these versions, there are item models (3D), as well as an item as a simple image (2D), and there is a 3D model in the GUI with a 2D icon (Version for minecraft: 1.21.5 for 3D with a 2D icon)
